title: Public Pressure and the Heterogeneous Effects of Voluntary Pollution Abatement
venue: Journal of the Association of Environmental and Resource Economists
abstract: We focus on the role of public pressure in environmental policy and describe a framework under which it is key to the success of voluntary pollution abatement. We hypothesize that a voluntary pollution abatement program changes the public pressure received by firms albeit differently for participants and nonparticipants. We describe these changes as well as the firm’s emission choices. We argue that, under our assumptions, the effectiveness of a voluntary pollution abatement program in lowering emissions depends on the cost from public scrutiny of participating firms and the associated risk of being labeled greenwashers: greater public scrutiny yields fewer program participants who free-ride on the reputation of the program, thereby increasing its effectiveness in lowering emissions. Our framework provides a narrative for reconciling the mixed empirical results on the effectiveness of voluntary pollution abatement programs and is supported by data from the EPA’s 33/50 program.
abstract_zh: 本文关注公众压力在环境政策中的作用，并构建了一个框架，在该框架下公众压力是自愿性污染减排成功的关键。我们假设，自愿性污染减排计划会改变企业所承受的公众压力，但对参与企业和未参与企业的影响有所不同。我们描述了这些变化以及企业的排放决策。我们认为，在本文的假设下，自愿性污染减排计划降低排放的效果，取决于参与企业所承受的公众审视成本，以及被贴上“漂绿”（greenwashers）标签的相关风险：公众审视越严格，搭便车地利用该计划声誉的参与者就越少，从而越能提高该计划降低排放的效果。本框架为调和自愿性污染减排计划效果的混杂实证结果提供了一种解释，并得到了美国环保署（EPA）33/50 计划数据的支持。

title: Local Air Quality Impacts of Shale Gas Development in Pennsylvania
abstract: We estimate the impact of shale gas development on particulate matter pollution using a quasi-experimental setting in Pennsylvania where some wells were developed to produce natural gas whereas other wells were permitted but not drilled. In doing so, we utilize a novel empirical approach drawing upon insights from atmospheric chemistry to account for windblown pollution spillovers in a difference-in-differences framework. Utilizing a high frequency, high resolution satellite-based measure of PM pollution between 2000 and 2018, we identify causal increases in PM2.5 concentration ranging from 0.017 μg/m3 to 0.062 μg/m3 in the vicinity of over 20,000 wells, resulting in approximately 20 additional deaths between 2010 and 2017.
abstract_zh: 本文利用宾夕法尼亚州的一个准实验场景，估计页岩气开发对颗粒物污染的影响：在该州，部分井被开发用于生产天然气，而另一些获得钻探许可但未实际钻探。为此，我们采用了一种新颖的实证方法，借鉴大气化学的见解，在双重差分框架中考虑风吹扬尘造成的污染溢出。利用 2000 年至 2018 年间高频、高分辨率的卫星 PM 污染测量数据，我们识别出在 20,000 多口井附近，PM2.5 浓度因果性地上升了 0.017 μg/m³ 至 0.062 μg/m³，在 2010 年至 2017 年间由此导致约 20 人额外死亡。

abstract: We consider private provision of an environmental public good and the link between voluntary pollution-abatement markets and the optimal level of mandatory environmental regulation. We show that voluntary abatement markets react to the level of mandatory abatement imposed and that an optimal regulatory policy must account for that reaction. We consider several assumptions about consumer behavior and find that the voluntary market's reaction to regulation depends on the motivating behavior of consumers. Whether the optimal level of mandatory abatement is higher than the level provided by traditional settings depends on the direction and magnitude of the voluntary market's reaction to changes in mandatory abatement.
abstract_zh: 我们考察环境公共物品的私人供给，以及自愿减排市场与强制性环境监管最优水平之间的联系。我们证明，自愿减排市场会对所施加的强制性减排水平作出反应，而最优监管政策必须考虑这种反应。我们考虑了关于消费者行为的若干假设，发现自愿市场对监管的反应取决于消费者的动机行为。强制性减排的最优水平是否高于传统设定下所提供的水平，取决于自愿市场对强制性减排变化作出反应的方向和幅度。

title: Total Factor Productivity and the Environmental Kuznets Curve: A Comment and Some Intuition
A Note on the 'Simple Analytics of the Environmental Kuznets Curve'
abstract: In a widely cited paper, Andreoni and Levinson (2001) argue that, under very mild restrictions on preferences, increasing returns to scale in pollution abatement are a sufficient condition for pollution to ultimately fall to zero with income growth. We show that the existence of an Environmental Kuznets Curve depends on the relative magnitudes of the returns to scale in abatement and in gross pollution, rather than on their absolute values. Increasing returns to scale in abatement by themselves are not sufficient for pollution to fall with income unless the returns to scale of abatement exceed the returns to the production of gross pollution.
abstract_zh: 在一篇被广泛引用的论文中，Andreoni 和 Levinson（2001）论证，在非常温和的偏好假设下，污染减排中的规模报酬递增是污染随收入增长最终降至零的充分条件。我们证明，环境库兹涅茨曲线（Environmental Kuznets Curve）是否存在，取决于减排与总污染产生中规模报酬的相对大小，而非其绝对值。减排中的规模报酬递增本身并不足以使污染随收入下降，除非减排的规模报酬超过了总污染生产的规模报酬。

World Oil: The Growing Case for International Oil Policy
abstract: Can the economic theory of depletion be reconciled with low petroleum prices? This article uses a revision of the theory, which reflects demand functions that rise in response to increasing world population and income. The magnitude of producers' and consumers' surplus is estimated under both competitive and monopolistic assumptions; the result indicates a present value comparable to or in excess of today's gross world economic product. Game theory suggests a framework that explains the interaction between oil pricing and military policy, and the economic incentives that result in a general pattern of recent market equilibrium crude oil prices often fluctuating with a $15–20 per barrel range. The analysis concludes that the economic incentives for political instability in the Persian Gulf will increase, and more formal methods of setting the international framework for Persian Gulf oil may be expected.
abstract_zh: 耗竭理论能否与低石油价格相调和？本文采用了该理论的一个修正版本，该版本反映了随世界人口和收入增长而上升的需求函数。本文分别在竞争性和垄断性假设下估计了生产者剩余和消费者剩余的规模；结果表明，其现值与当今全球经济总产值相当，甚至更高。博弈论提供了一个框架，用以解释石油定价与军事政策之间的相互作用，以及导致近期原油市场均衡价格常在每桶 15 至 20 美元区间波动的经济激励。分析得出结论认为，波斯湾地区政治不稳定的经济激励将会增强，并且可以预期将出现更为正式的方法来设定波斯湾石油的国际框架。
